news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.92 (vs ₹1.21 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.92 (up from ₹1.21 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹740.5m (up 45% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹27.8m (up ₹39.3m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.8% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 56% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 20% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.
